title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Showdown Ending)
summary: Return to King of the Bridge for the 'Showdown' award: finish with the two kings as the only remaining pieces. He builds a material lead via accusations (Rule 9 queen jumped, Rule 2, Rule 24, Rule 12 lazy king) and payback cheats, uses 'gifts' (bombs/landmines he can place on enemy pieces) and then reduces the board to king vs king. The goose appears to 'watch the victory'; with his payback cheat he puts the troll king on the goose, which flies it off the board ('out of town'), triggering the ending cutscene where the troll is carried away across an endless lake, after which he becomes the troll. Run time 34:44.
rules: Showdown award: end with only the two kings on the board.
Gifts/bombs: obtained via the bishop/ascended captures; can be placed onto opponent pieces as landmines (exact acquisition not fully established).
Goose: randomly appears; a king placed on the goose can be carried off the board, ending the game.
Payback cheats can be used to move an opponent piece (e.g. put the troll king on the goose).

Base game rules as in WEYUcaJTBso (King of the Bridge): accusation via Space + rule book; correct accusation = you may cheat once; false accusation = turn forfeited + troll revenge cheat; pawns move orthogonally (forward/back/sideways) not diagonally; only knights jump; only bishops may go 'out of town' off-board; troll king death passes crown to another piece; queen can't take king; slippery tiles; board flips.
win_condition: Defeat the troll with only both kings remaining -> Showdown award (troll king removed via goose/out of town).
